docs.purpose: The user's saved jobs, grouped into three urgency bands: needs action now, starting soon, and further out. Cards flash amber when the underlying permit has changed since the user last opened it. Swiping a card removes it with a three-second undo window, and a floating button opens a search to claim a new job onto the board. When the subscription has lapsed and the upgrade screen was dismissed, the board is replaced with blurred locked placeholders.
docs.data_story: It reads nothing from the database directly. Every value arrives through 3 contracts: `/api/leads/flight-board`, `/api/leads/save`, `/api/user-profile`. Behind those contracts, the data comes from `entitlements`, `lead_views`, `permits`, `trade_forecasts` and `user_profiles`, and writes land on `entitlements`, `lead_views` and `user_profiles`. It also holds client-side state in `tabBarStore`, `paywallStore` and `flightBoardSeenStore`, which is the part a server-driven projection has to absorb or justify.
docs.under_126: **REBUILD** — it holds Layer-3 state (`tabBarStore`, `paywallStore` and `flightBoardSeenStore`) and drives writes, so a client decision has to be re-homed on the server before the projection can be honest. It renders through the LIST renderer (a collection with declared pagination, recycling and empty/offline states), reading by reference: `/api/leads/flight-board`, `/api/leads/save`, `/api/user-profile`. Its `owns.components[]` declares `mobile/src/components/feed/FlightCard.tsx`, `mobile/src/components/feed/FlightCardSkeleton.tsx`, `mobile/src/components/feed/TemporalSectionHeader.tsx` and `mobile/src/components/feed/EmptyBoardState.tsx`.

identity.owner: unassigned (no CODEOWNERS file and no owner registry exists in the repo — measured 2026-09-15)

versioning.why: FlightBoardResultSchema.parse() runs on every response; the schema tolerates added keys but its temporal_group enum and the non-nullable permit_num/lifecycle_stalled fields are pinned by mobile/__tests__/useFlightBoard.test.ts.

inputs.why: The board is one GET /api/leads/flight-board response; the only non-contract input is the MMKV last-seen map that decides which cards flash amber.

outputs.why: A swipe removes the card from the cached board immediately and holds the POST for a 3-second undo window; the mutation is force-committed on unmount and on pull-to-refresh so a pending delete is never silently abandoned.
outputs.rollback: The pre-swipe FlightBoardResult snapshot is written back with queryClient.setQueryData on mutation error (flight-board.tsx:147-151) and on Undo (flight-board.tsx:215-227).

state.why: flightBoardSeenStore persists a permitId → updated_at map to MMKV under the Spec 77 §3.2 canonical key; it is the only thing that decides the amber flash, and it survives cold boot. paywallStore (in-memory) and the tabBar shared values sit alongside it.

fields.name: seenMap
fields.canonical_writer: useFlightBoardSeenStore.markSeen, called from the flight-job detail screen

staleness.why: useFlightBoard overrides the global defaults with the Spec 77 §5 numbers — 30-second staleTime, 1-hour gcTime — so the board re-fetches far more eagerly than the lead feed.

session.why: /api/leads/flight-board sits under the `/api/leads` prefix that route-guard classifies `authenticated`; the handler resolves the uid with getCurrentUserContext before any query.

rls_class.why: The board IS the user's own lead_views rows — a Class-A owner-scoped table whose policies key on auth.uid(); permits and trade_forecasts are joined in as Class-B default-deny reference data.

guards.rate_bucket: none — the flight-board route calls no withRateLimit (src/app/api/leads/flight-board/route.ts has no rate-limit import)

checks.why: mobile/__tests__/useFlightBoard.test.ts pins FlightBoardItemSchema/FlightBoardResultSchema including the temporal_group enum and the empty-array case.
FLIGHT_BOARD_QUERY_KEY is a frozen module constant (["flight-board"]) shared by the screen, the removal mutation and the search sheet — the cleanest key in the app; nothing can drift it.
boardData.length === 0 renders EmptyBoardState with a route back to the feed (flight-board.tsx:315-318); no render test covers it.
isError renders "Failed to load board." plus a Retry (flight-board.tsx:308-314); the ZodError path instead throws to the ErrorBoundary via throwOnError.
OfflineBanner is mounted at flight-board.tsx:300 and mobile/__tests__/offline.test.ts locks the MMKV persister behind it.
mobile/__tests__/flightBoardSeenStore.test.ts locks the Spec 77 §3.2 rule that drives the amber flash — strict !== comparison, first-sight rows do not flash, sign-out resets the map.
Exactly one interactive element (the search FAB) is labelled; the cards, section headers and the UNDO action are not — expected to stay non-zero until a labelling pass runs.

errors.why: A failed board fetch renders a centred "Failed to load board." with a Retry inside the screen; a failed removal silently restores the snapshot with no user-visible message.

classes.ui: One silent session refresh, then the inline "Failed to load board." retry block.
ZodError re-thrown to the root ErrorBoundary (useFlightBoard throwOnError).

emits.why: flight_board_viewed is wrapped in `if (__DEV__)` so it never fires in a production build; the only production events from this screen come from the shared removal path, which emits none.

offers.why: No sponsored placement is rendered: the only slot component in the Expo tree is SponsorSlot, and it returns null unless EXPO_PUBLIC_PARCEL_SPONSORS=1.

metering.why: Nothing here is counted: the Spec 126 §7 usage ledger table does not exist (grep for usage_events in the introspected drizzle schema returns 0 hits), and the only quota-shaped counter, user_profiles.lead_views_count, is incremented solely by POST /api/leads/view, which has no mobile caller.

config.why: The surface consumes no registered logic variable: the only server-side tunable in this path, user_profiles.radius_cap_km, is a per-user admin column, not a logic_variables row.

sharing.why: /api/leads/flight-board is also the cold-boot cache the flight-job detail screen reads first, and /api/leads/save is shared with the feed, the lead detail and the search sheet.

limitations.what: Only the FAB carries an accessible label; the cards, the section headers and the UNDO action are unlabelled.
limitations.measured: grep -c "accessibilityLabel|accessibilityRole" flight-board.tsx → 2, both on the same FAB Pressable (flight-board.tsx:384-385).

limitations.what: The production build emits nothing for this screen — its single analytics event is DEV-gated.

notes: flight_board_viewed is DEV-only, so the flight board has ZERO production telemetry. Removal is a POST to /api/leads/save with saved:false — not a DELETE — and the pending delete is force-committed on unmount and on pull-to-refresh. The undo snackbar UNDO target relies on hitSlop rather than a 44px box.

programme.why: Flight center — the other product. Fenced from the parcel tool by Spec 128 R-03; inventoried only.
